long_biography.plain_text:
Willadssen spent more than twenty years developing an industrial-property portfolio around Moss. Marine Trading combined operating warehouses with a land bank for future projects, while collaboration with local partners added tenants and new buildings. The business concentrated on logistics facilities and industrial land, creating a recurring commercial-property operation around local tenants.

In early 2024, SRW sold Marine Trading and its nine-property portfolio to NREP Logicenters. The transaction transferred about 78,000 square metres of logistics space and substantial development land to the Nordic real-estate investor. Willadssen remains sole owner of SRW, with separate interests in advisory services, real estate and a property fund. He no longer holds an operating role in the sold portfolio.
